  (define (paint out src r c color)
    (if (= (at src r c) 0) (set-cell out r c color) out))
  (define (scan input reversed live orientation)
    (define anchors
      (for*/list ((r (in-range (- (rows input) 1)))
                  (c (in-range (- (cols input) 1)))) (list r c)))
    (for/fold ((out input)) ((p (in-list (if reversed (reverse anchors) anchors))))
      (let* ((r (first p)) (c0 (second p)) (src (if live out input))
             (a (at src r c0)) (b (at src r (+ c0 1)))
             (c (at src (+ r 1) c0)) (d (at src (+ r 1) (+ c0 1))))
        (cond
          ((and (!= orientation 2) (and (> a 0) (= a d)) (and (= b 0) (= c 0)))
           (paint (paint out src r (+ c0 1) a) src (+ r 1) c0 a))
          ((and (!= orientation 1) (and (> b 0) (= b c)) (and (= a 0) (= d 0)))
           (paint (paint out src r c0 b) src (+ r 1) (+ c0 1) b))
          
          (else out)))))
  (for/fold ((state g)) ((pass-index (in-range 1))) (scan (scan state #f #f 1) #f #f 2))))

rival_meanings.anti_only: Selected snapshot count, recognizing only the top-right/bottom-left diagonal.
rival_meanings.anti_then_main: Each selected pass is an anti-only snapshot followed by a consuming main-only snapshot.
rival_meanings.axis_pairs: Selected snapshots; additionally complete equal adjacent horizontal or vertical pairs.
rival_meanings.endpoint_mismatch: Selected snapshots; unequal nonzero diagonal endpoints qualify, using the top endpoint color.
rival_meanings.fill8: Selected snapshots, painting eligible zero corners color 8 instead of the diagonal color.
rival_meanings.fixedpoint: Consume canonical snapshot passes until unchanged, bounded by the number of cells.
rival_meanings.ignore_blockers: Selected snapshots; fill any zero opposite corner despite a nonzero blocker.
rival_meanings.inplace_forward1: One row-major scan; each window reads the accumulated output.
rival_meanings.inplace_forward2: Two row-major scans; each window reads the accumulated output.
rival_meanings.inplace_reverse1: One reverse-row-major scan; each window reads the accumulated output.
rival_meanings.inplace_reverse2: Two reverse-row-major scans; each window reads the accumulated output.
rival_meanings.main_only: Selected snapshot count, recognizing only the top-left/bottom-right diagonal.
rival_meanings.main_then_anti: Each selected pass is a main-only snapshot followed by a consuming anti-only snapshot.
rival_meanings.reverse_second_snapshot: The first snapshot is row-major; only a selected second snapshot reverses traversal.
rival_meanings.reverse_snapshot: Selected consuming snapshots with reverse-row-major conflict resolution.
rival_meanings.skip_A: Repeat the selected number of passes but always read the original input.
rival_meanings.snapshot3: Three complete consuming snapshot passes, independently of the selected count.

scope: Four episodes only; all 6+4 intended labels checked. Exactly the first two demos determine every survivor. No universal identifiability, owner acceptance, or training admission.
